rules: Invincible rejected contact does not consume accepted hit memory, explode, or clear held steering
Accepted contact clears the held target and retains the current movement direction until the original mesh lifetime expires
The same travelling shot can hit later targets, once per original target receipt, with original impact explosion and sound
The receiver-private accepted direction persists across owner replacements and NEXT tables; no remote HP authority or delayed hit replay is added

supersededProductRule.rule: immediate projectile termination on first accepted contact
supersededProductRule.reason: User corrected desired behavior in the V56 player feedback request
